chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
A false oath leaves homes deserted of their inhabitants.

key_terms.الْكَاذِبَةُ: false or lying, describing the oath

ai.seo_question: What are the consequences of a false oath in hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that swearing falsely brings destructive consequences upon households. The hadith warns against lying by oath, presenting it as a moral and social wrong that leads to ruin and desolation.
